It also states that release workflows stay on literal Blacksmith runners. This is test documentation only. I could not verify the actual script, the build.md#ci-runner-routing anchor, or the workflow permissions it claims to pin, since they are not in the supplied evidence. Those are unverified contracts. A later pass could check that the CI routing step (fork PR handling, label grants, read-only permissions) is secure. That would be a CI supply-chain concern outside this provider threat model, and it is not evidenced here as a regression. No findings.
